content: st.data_editor(df, num_rows='dynamic') is the idiomatic Streamlit pattern for an add/remove-row form grid: users add rows via the '+' toolbar icon or by typing in the shaded row below the table, and delete via row-checkbox + delete icon/key. Returns the edited DataFrame directly (no separate add/remove callbacks needed). Known limitation: added rows are always appended at the end; sorting is unsupported while num_rows='dynamic'.
